parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) API operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The name of the protected object to query. You can set this parameter to precisely query a protected object that has been added to WAF.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
